# Tako

> Tako is a data intelligence platform. The Tako MCP server lets AI agents search a knowledge base of 100K+ curated charts, get grounded answers, fetch underlying source content, and run a multi-step Answer Agent. It is a hosted remote MCP server on Cloudflare Workers.

## Documentation

- [MCP Server Setup](https://github.com/TakoData/tako-mcp): Connect to the hosted Tako MCP server
- [API Reference](https://tako.com/docs/): Full REST API documentation
- [Chart Gallery](https://tako.com/gallery): Browse example charts and visualizations
- [OpenAPI Spec](https://tako.com/openapi.yaml): Machine-readable API specification

## Connecting

Hosted endpoint: `https://mcp.tako.com/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).

- CLI/desktop hosts (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf): pass `Authorization: Bearer <TAKO_API_TOKEN>`. Get a token at tako.com -> account settings -> API tokens.
- Web hosts (Claude.ai, ChatGPT): connect via the server's OAuth flow; no token config needed.

Optional tools: the Answer Agent (`tako_agent`) is opt-in and off by default. Enable it by adding `?tools=agent` to the endpoint URL: `https://mcp.tako.com/mcp?tools=agent`. `agent` is an alias — the server picks the single-call `tako_agent` on most clients and the `tako_agent_start` / `tako_agent_wait` pair on ChatGPT. Unknown `?tools=` values are ignored, so a typo never breaks the connection.

Tools are discovered at runtime via `tools/list`. There is no per-call `api_token` argument — auth is connection-level.

## Available Tools

### tako_search
Fast search over Tako's curated knowledge graph (and the live web when asked) for charts and live data on any topic. The top result auto-renders inline as an interactive chart on MCP Apps hosts. Returns `cards` (structured Tako cards) plus `web_results` and a `request_id`. A card is metadata plus a chart, NOT its underlying rows — to read or analyze the actual rows or data, pass `include_contents: true` for a small free inline preview, or call `tako_contents` on the result URL for the full data. For deep, multi-step research — or when search returns nothing — use `tako_agent` (opt-in; enable with `?tools=agent`).

Parameters:
- `query` (string, required): Natural-language search query
- `sources` (array): both by default (`["data","web"]`); pass `["data"]` for curated data only or `["web"]` for live web only. (`"tako"` is a legacy synonym for `"data"`.)
- `effort` (string, "fast" | "instant"): Search effort; "fast" (default) or "instant" (fastest, cached embeds). Omit for fast.
- `count` (integer, 1-20, default 10): Maximum results per source
- `include_contents` (boolean, default false): When true, inline each result's data directly in the response (Tako cards: a small FREE preview of the most-recent rows — call `tako_contents` for the full, priced export; web results: page text, billed per page) so you can read it without a follow-up `tako_contents` call.
- `country_code` (string, default "US"): ISO country code
- `locale` (string, default "en-US"): Locale

### tako_answer
Ask a factual question and get back a single grounded, citation-backed text answer.

Parameters:
- `query` (string, required): Natural-language question
- `sources` (array, optional): both by default (`["data","web"]`); pass `["data"]` for curated data only or `["web"]` for live web only. (`"tako"` is a legacy synonym for `"data"`.)
- `country_code` (string, default "US"): ISO country code
- `locale` (string, default "en-US"): Locale

### tako_contents
Fetch the actual rows or data behind a result URL — the step after `tako_search`/`tako_answer` when you need the real underlying data to compute over, quote, or reason about (a search result carries only metadata and a chart, not its data). A Tako card URL returns that card's data (CSV by default, or JSON); any other URL — a web result — returns that page's extracted full text. One URL per call.

Parameters:
- `url` (string, required): The result URL to fetch — a Tako card's `webpage_url`, or a web-result URL
- `content_format` (string, optional): Tako cards only — serialization of the data: `csv` (default, text in `data`), `json_records` (row objects in `records`), or `json_compact` (compact columns+rows in `dataset`). Ignored for web URLs (always text).
- `max_rows` (integer, 1-2000, optional): Tako cards only — max rows to return. Omit for the free 20-row default; raise up to 2,000 for a larger (priced) export. Ignored for web URLs (always full text).
- `mode` (string, "inline" | "url", default "inline"): Delivery only, not row count — `inline` returns the data in the response so you can read it; `url` returns a short-lived presigned `download_url` to the same file.

Typical flow: `tako_search` to find cards/results → `tako_contents` on a result URL to pull the actual rows or data for analysis.

### tako_visualize
Create an embeddable Tako card directly from your OWN structured data (not from search), backed by Tako's Thin-Viz API. Provide one or more typed components; the card auto-renders inline as a chart and returns share/embed URLs.

Parameters:
- `components` (array, required): One or more `{ component_type, config, component_variant? }` objects. `component_type` is one of: header, generic_timeseries, categorical_bar, choropleth, data_table_chart, histogram, pie, table, financial_boxes, timeline, treemap, heatmap, marimekko, boxplot, waterfall, sankey, scatter, bubble, top_level_metric, person_card. `config` holds that type's data (validated server-side). The optional `component_variant` string selects a type variant (e.g. 'simple', 'financial'). `person_card` must be the only component.
- `title` (string, optional): Card title
- `description` (string, optional): Card description
- `source` (string, optional): Data source attribution shown in the footer
- `height` (integer, 100-2000, optional): Chart height in pixels
- `normalize_currencies` (string, optional): Target ISO 4217 code to convert currency-denominated datasets

### tako_agent
Opt-in tool — off by default; enable with `?tools=agent` on the endpoint URL (see Connecting). Run Tako's Answer Agent for complex, multi-step data questions — transformations, aggregations, comparisons across many entities, and multi-hop reasoning. Returns a synthesized answer plus supporting chart cards. On ChatGPT, exposed as the `tako_agent_start` / `tako_agent_wait` pair to fit the host's tool-call timeout model.

Parameters:
- `query` (string, required): The deep/analytical question

### get_credit_balance
Check the connected account's API credit balance.

Parameters: none.
